PlanCoverageGap.description: One member Spec's coverage gap against the Plan: the User Stories its scope claims that no criterion claims yet (DR-PS-14).

claims_no_stories.description: The version's story section names no User Story at all: an empty scope admits no coverage, so no Ticket graph could ever cover this Spec.

spec_number.description: The member Spec whose stories stay uncovered.

uncovered.description: Every uncovered User Story, full identities in scope order.

PlanCycle.description: One dependency cycle the planning diagnostics report: a group of member Specs mutually reachable through the Plan's dependency edges, so no execution order exists among them (DR-PS-18).

spec_numbers.description: The ring's member Spec numbers, ascending.

PlanInvalidProfile.description: One profile reference that resolves to no catalogue entry. This is the invalid-profile diagnostics interface of DR-PS-18: the execution profile catalogue feeds the entries (KAN-S7, T38), so the list rides empty until the catalogue exists.

reference.description: The referenced profile identity, as written where it was referenced.

description: Response payload for the `plan.diagnostics` query: the blocking diagnostics of one graph (DR-PS-18).

blocking.description: Whether any diagnostic blocks the Plan's Ticket graph from becoming executable: a cycle, a coverage gap, or an invalid profile reference.

coverage_gaps.description: One entry per member Spec whose stories stay uncovered; the story-to-criterion-to-Ticket coverage matrix completes the picture with graph approval (T23).

cycles.description: Every dependency cycle the diagnosed graph holds.

invalid_profiles.description: Profile references resolving to no catalogue entry; the catalogue feeds this list (KAN-S7, T38).

title: PlanDiagnosticsResponse
